newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-BE WARY OF THE SO-CALLED MINNOWS, SAYS MALDINI.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BE WARY OF THE SO-CALLED MINNOWS, SAYS MALDINI.

text.p: Italy captain Paolo Maldini has warned his team mates about treating both Moldova and Georgia as lightweights in their World Cup qualifying group.
Italy, who failed to progress beyond the first phase of Euro 96, begin their European group two qualifying campaign away to Moldova on Saturday and are at home to Georgia on October 9.
"You have to be careful," said Maldini on Wednesday. "It's up to us to make this an easy start."
Maldini, capped 71 times, rejected suggestions that he had been below form both for both AC Milan this season and for his country during Euro 96.
"I'm fine now and I was fine before...Negative judgements and positive judgments can both be exaggerated...," he said.
